# `nlink-lab archive extract`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Check an archive's checksums and validate it, extracting it into a directory (default `./<lab>/`)

Usage: nlink-lab archive extract [OPTIONS] <ARCHIVE>

Arguments:
  <ARCHIVE>
          

Options:
      --dir <DIR>
          

      --no-reparse
          Use the archive's rendered topology instead of parsing its NLL (an archive made by a newer nlink-lab)

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
